other_conditions: Start-ups must be certified by the Start‑up Promotion Cell (SPC) and possess a valid start‑up certificate number
The IP must be technology‑based or use technology to enhance an existing product or service
The applicant must have already filed or been granted the IP with the concerned authority
The applicant must have paid the mandatory government and attorney fees for the IP filing
Only expenditures incurred after the notification of the Goa Start‑up Policy 2017 and paid digitally are eligible
The same IP cannot be claimed under any other central or state scheme
The application must be submitted within 6 months of incurring the relevant expenditure
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of up to 50 % of IP filing costs, capped at ₹2,00,000 for national IP and ₹5,00,000 for international IP, for a maximum of 200 startups per year.
